identificationModule.briefTitle: A Trial of Cabozantinib in Patients With Advanced, Low Proliferative NEN G3
identificationModule.officialTitle: CABONEN - A Phase II Trial of Cabozantinib in Patients With Advanced, Low Proliferative NEN G3

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The main objective of this clinical trial represents the evaluation of efficacy of the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Cabozantinib in patients with NEN G3 with a proliferation rate of Ki67 20 - 60%.

interventions.name: Cabozantinib
interventions.description: Cabozantinib is administered orally at the dose of 60 mg per day..

primaryOutcomes.measure: Evaluate the efficacy of Cabozantinib treatment via DCR after 6 months.
primaryOutcomes.description: Disease control rate (DCR) 6 months after treatment start .

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Evaluate short- and long term efficacy of Cabozantinib treatment via DCR.
secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR 3 and 12 months after treatment start.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Evaluate short- and long term efficacy of Cabozantinib treatment via ORR.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate (ORR) 3, 6 and 12 months after treatment start and best objective response rate.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Evaluate short- and long term efficacy of Cabozantinib treatment via PFS.
Evaluate short- and long term efficacy of Cabozantinib treatment via OS.
Assess quality-of-life during and after Cabozantinib treatment.
secondaryOutcomes.description: EORTC QLQ-C30 Quality of Life Questionnaire monthly for 12 months after treatment start and after 15 months. Different questions regarding Quality of Life on a scale of 1 - 4. The lower the numbers, the better the quality of Life.

otherOutcomes.measure: Safety of Cabozantinib via AE and SAE assessment.
otherOutcomes.description: Adverse events and serious adverse events will be assessed in contingency tables.
